aions_core/agi_core.py.why: It walks a question through goals and evidence and reports the chain with a confidence figure, rather than searching a store for the best passage.

aions_core/agi_unified.py.why: The parts it wires together are thinking, learning and self-improvement, not the search and wording components behind a chat front door.

aions_core/evaluator_engine.py.why: It hands out a score out of a hundred and a letter grade for answer quality, not a report on whether services are up or fast.

aions_core/server/facts_loader.py.why: Its whole job is telling how many known facts a question touches so retrieval can judge relevance, not keeping the fact files tidy on disk.

aions_core/tools/harvest_memory.py.why: It gathers chunk files scattered across folders into one library, which is plain file bookkeeping rather than loading anything into a similarity database.

control_plane/blends/analyze_blend.py.why: It writes up a past mistake with its error class and root cause so lessons accumulate, rather than grading a single answer as good or bad.

control_plane/executor.py.why: It takes one numbered step of a stored plan and points it at a local or remote machine; the policy call is a gate it consults, not the thing it is.

control_plane/node_agent/agent.py.why: It is the little program living on a worker box reporting load and accepting commands, not a health loop that repairs the system it watches.

control_plane/scheduler.py.why: The queue it builds is the human owner's deadlines and cases from their profile, not steps of a machine job plan.

scripts/aions_indexer.py.why: It keeps the fast name-lookup list fresh so file searches avoid walking the disk, rather than analysing code imports or duplicate files.

scripts/calendar_e2e_smoke.py.why: It confirms the owner's outside calendar and sign-in actually work end to end, not that internal services are up.

scripts/chatgpt_parser_v2.py.why: It recovers conversations, titles and account details out of another app's export, which is intake of outside text rather than surveying files on the drives.

scripts/demo_windows_final.py.why: It is a runnable show-and-tell of folders, zips and notepad from start to finish, not the registry and executor machinery it calls into.

scripts/run_mcp_server.sh.why: Its purpose is bringing the tool service up in stdio or http mode; the environment variables it sets are part of that launch, not general installation groundwork.

aions_core/agi_soft_retrieval.py.why: It shortlists candidates with word matching then re-scores them by meaning, which is the act of searching and ranking even though the scorer is trainable.

aions_core/cbms_memory.py.why: It owns the chunks directory, their identifiers and the thinking log on disk, rather than being a similarity database with sessions and scores.

aions_core/server/cbms_doctor.py.why: It hunts broken JSON, missing fields and dangling references in the chunk pile, not whether a produced answer is trustworthy.

aions_core/server/pocket_qc.py.why: It is the gatekeeper stamping text pass, fail or retry before it becomes knowledge, not a rule about which actions a role may take.

aions_core/tools/test_api.py.why: It just pokes the assistant's own query endpoint to prove it is reachable, not the tool-protocol handshake or a whole-system health sweep.

control_plane/api.py.why: This is the command centre's front door for plans, steps and node registration, not the assistant's question-and-answer endpoint.

mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/run_server..why: It exists solely to correct the working directory and boot the tool service over piped streams, not to provide any ability itself.

mcpServers/VS_CODE_MCP_CODEX/src/provide.why: It picks which screen-control and file-search backend suits this machine, which is about those abilities themselves rather than the protocol carrying them.

scripts/ingest_tier1_chroma.py.why: It pushes selected chunks into named Chroma sessions as embeddings, rather than tidying the plain chunk files it reads from.

scripts/project_scanner.py.why: It maps imports, duplicates, orphans and circular links across a repo into a report, not a quick name lookup for finding a file.

scripts/test_google_integration.py.why: It validates the owner's Gmail and Calendar wiring and scopes, not whether the encrypted credential store itself works.

scripts/test_skill_engine_foundation.py.why: It is an end-to-end tryout showing discovery, chaining and recipe replay working, not the registry and recipe machinery being demonstrated.

scripts/test_skill_open_apps.py.why: It opens real apps to demonstrate that an already-open program is not opened twice, rather than being the desktop control layer it drives.

scripts/verify_python_env.py.why: It refuses to continue when the running interpreter is not the pinned one, which is groundwork before anything runs, not live service health.

server/store.py.why: It is the Chroma wrapper with sessions, similarity scores and expiry pruning, not the folder of plain knowledge files and its manifest.
